name: A_ClientsideACSExecute
signature: int A_ClientsideACSExecute (str script, [int arg1, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4])

name: A_SetSpecies
summary: Changes the calling actor's (or pointer target's) species. Use "None" to remove species.

name: A_Jump
signature: state A_Jump (int chance, int offset, ...) | state A_Jump (int chance, str "state", ...)
summary: Randomly advances to a different state/frame based on chance.
